info.description:
# DummyJSON API Testing Portfolio

## Overview

This project demonstrates API Testing skills using Postman against the DummyJSON REST API

## Modules

- Products
    
- Authentications
    
- Users
    
- Carts
    

## Test Techniques

- Positive Testing
    
- Negative Testing
    
- Boundary Value Analysis (BVA)
    
- Pagination Testing
    

## Tools

- Postman
    
- Newman
    
- Javascript

- Retrieve product by ID
    
- Search products
    
- Pagination
    
- Boundary Value Testing (BVA)
    
- Negative Testing
